svg.text: Prompt + data → live full-stack app · dashboards · decks · PDFs. In-browser Sandpack preview, Gemini-powered Node/Express BFF, DuckDB/Postgres storage.

g.text: via docker-compose: web · bff · db(pg) · markitdown

svg.text: Browser — React SPA (Vite) · src/App.tsx routed shell
HTTPS · JSON & SSE · Bearer-token auth · key stays server-side
Middleware: security (CORS + headers) · auth (Bearer → tenantId) · ratelimit (request rate + token/cost quota) · express.json (64 MB) · metrics (AsyncLocalStorage tokens/cost) · /health

Build handoff: WorkbenchPage extract → /build auto-fires spec dashboard build with analyst evidence directive
